entries.test: real model: wiki synthesis and critic return schema-valid, evidence-bound, review-gated output
entries.reason: This opt-in test sends synthetic content to a configured model provider and checks evidence-bound, review-gated output; provider credentials and explicit model-test consent are required.

entries.test: real model evaluation: labeled preference extraction and micro/deep/strategic cross-domain hypotheses
entries.reason: This opt-in evaluation exercises preference extraction and three model-backed hypothesis modes with synthetic labeled data; provider access and explicit model-test consent are required.

entries.test: real Claude Code: hooks installed by the adapter capture a real task; another principal recalls it; the host works with MDB broken or absent
entries.reason: This integration invokes an authenticated Claude Code CLI through installed hooks and checks cross-principal recall and fail-open behavior; the real host is intentionally opt-in.

entries.test: real Codex CLI: trusted hooks pass actual lifecycle payloads, capture without memory-write instructions, and fail open
entries.reason: This integration invokes an authenticated Codex CLI with trusted lifecycle hooks and verifies capture without memory-write instructions; the real host is intentionally opt-in.

entries.test: real Claude Code and Codex remote capture recover after HTTP outage and server restart
entries.reason: This end-to-end recovery test needs authenticated Claude Code and Codex CLIs plus the remote-host opt-in to validate capture after an HTTP outage and server restart.

entries.test: Codex itself reports the project hooks as untrusted; trust is recorded only on explicit request, only for Engram's own commands, and a changed hook loses it
entries.reason: This test probes Codex's own hook trust behavior and cannot establish the host decision without the Codex CLI executable installed on the test machine.

entries.test: a project Codex does not trust has its hooks ignored entirely, and init says so instead of reporting success
entries.reason: This test verifies the actual Codex host ignoring untrusted project hooks and therefore requires the Codex CLI executable on the test machine.

entries.test: real model: incremental wiki compilation obeys the safety gates (and we record whether it also complied with the citation rules)
entries.reason: This opt-in test checks model-backed incremental wiki compilation and citation reporting on synthetic content; a configured provider and explicit model-test consent are required.

entries.test: awk: gawk --sandbox runs programs but cannot run commands, redirect, pipe, or read program files
entries.reason: The sandbox contract specifically depends on GNU awk's --sandbox option; the Darwin BSD awk implementation cannot provide equivalent security coverage.

entries.test: sed: GNU sed --sandbox runs scripts but cannot execute, read or write files
entries.reason: The sandbox contract specifically depends on GNU sed's --sandbox option; the Darwin BSD sed implementation cannot provide equivalent security coverage.

entries.test: launchd plist is well-formed (plutil -lint on macOS), runs only the explicit worker command, and escapes special characters
entries.reason: The plist syntax validation invokes Apple's plutil and is explicitly skipped outside Darwin; Linux runs the systemd service-unit checks separately.
